verbatim_quote.original: F4 DISPUTED — unit bodies (read these as ground truth): 5 Python services carry 'Environment=MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http'; mcp-telegram.service carries MCP_TRANSPORT=http + MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1 + MCP_PORT=8106. No reboot-to-stdio risk.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: F4 DISPUTED — unit bodies (read these as ground truth): 5 Python services carry 'Environment=MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http'; mcp-telegram.service carries MCP_TRANSPORT=http + MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1 + MCP_PORT=8106. No reboot-to-stdio risk.

extracted_decision.summary: Dispute F4; treat the unit bodies as ground truth; no reboot-to-stdio risk exists.
extracted_decision.rationale: The systemd unit bodies explicitly set MCP_TRANSPORT for the five Python services and telegram uses http with loopback host and port.
alternatives: Accept QA's finding of missing transport pins
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Accepting unit configuration as evidence versus demanding live bind proof; Avoiding unnecessary rework versus verifying reboot behavior
